scope: Three-bucket disposition adjudication for the existing 50-case development set; offline scoring only.

provenance.source: User physician reassessment in the current conversation on 2026-09-15
provenance.statement: Explicit user corrections supersede the mapped v2 reference for C25, C32, C34 and C38. C22 and C47 retain their mapped targets with new review annotations. No model output or prompt is changed.

scoring.positiveEndpoint: Any clinician action now: ASYNC_PHYSICIAN or URGENT_ESCALATION.
scoring.note: False positives and false negatives must name the endpoint. Prior-reference false positives on C32, C34 and C38 are not model false positives. A three-bucket urgency mismatch can occur while both routes are positive for clinician action.

limitations: This is an unblinded post-output reference revision, not a new independent validation set or evidence of model improvement.
A disposition label is not a patient reply and does not grade medication safety, watchful-waiting instructions, or pregnancy precautions.
C25 is newly included in the 50-case denominator; v2 scores retain their original 49-case denominator.
The three-bucket taxonomy does not distinguish same-day in-person care from immediate emergency action.

cases.message: Hi, I've had a runny nose and a mild sore throat for about 2 days. No fever, I'm still eating and drinking fine. Should I be worried?
45M. I've had crushing pressure in the center of my chest for the last 30 minutes, it's going into my left arm and I feel sweaty and a bit sick to my stomach. I have high cholesterol.

I've been feeling really hopeless for a few weeks now. Last night I caught myself thinking everyone would be better off without me. I don't know what to do.
Could I get a refill on my losartan? I've been on 50mg once a day for about 2 years, my blood pressure is well controlled, last home reading was 122/78.

30F, I'm 32 weeks pregnant. I've had a bad headache that won't go away, my vision is a little blurry, and my hands and face look puffy.
50M. For a few weeks I've had pain in my upper right belly that comes and goes, usually after a fatty meal. No fever, no yellowing of my skin or eyes.
I have a small itchy red rash on my forearm since I did some gardening yesterday. It's not spreading and I'm breathing fine.

I'd like to get tested for STIs. No symptoms, but I had a new partner recently and want to be safe.

I've been dizzy on and off for a few days. The room spins when I roll over or turn my head in bed, but it settles. No chest pain, no weakness, no headache.
